name: SlaFwd

q.description: 查询张量, shape (B, H, L, D); float16/bfloat16

k.description: 键张量, 与 q 同形状同 dtype (MHA)

v.description: 值张量, 与 q 同形状同 dtype

topk.description: 每个 query 块选 key 块的比例, float ∈ (0, 1]

W_l.description: 线性分支投影矩阵 (proj_l, 无偏置), shape (D, D), 与 q 同 dtype

out.description: 融合输出 o = o_s + o_l, shape (B, H, L, D), 与 q 同 dtype

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

_MQ_CHUNK = 16


def _block_mean(x, BLK):
    device = x.device
    B, H, L, D = x.shape
    LB = (L + BLK - 1) // BLK
    pad = LB * BLK - L
    xp = F.pad(x.float(), (0, 0, 0, pad)).view(B, H, LB, BLK, D)
    cnt = torch.full((LB,), BLK, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    if pad:
        cnt[-1] = BLK - pad
    return (xp.sum(3) / cnt.view(1, 1, LB, 1)).to(x.dtype)


def run(q, k, v, topk, feature_map, BLKQ, BLKK, W_l):
    device = q.device
    B, H, L, D = q.shape
    assert k.shape == v.shape == q.shape
    assert q.dtype == k.dtype == v.dtype
    assert isinstance(feature_map, str) and feature_map in ("elu", "relu", "softmax")
    assert 0.0 < topk <= 1.0

    dtype = q.dtype

    arg_k = k - k.float().mean(dim=-2, keepdim=True).to(dtype)
    qm = _block_mean(q, BLKQ)
    km = _block_mean(arg_k, BLKK)
    pooled = (qm.float() @ km.float().transpose(-1, -2)).to(dtype)
    NK = pooled.shape[-1]
    real_topk = min(NK, int(topk * NK))
    assert real_topk >= 1
    lut = torch.topk(pooled.float(), real_topk, dim=-1, sorted=False).indices
    lut = lut.sort(dim=-1).values

    scale = D ** -0.5
    if feature_map == "softmax":
        fmap = lambda x: F.softmax(x, dim=-1)
    elif feature_map == "elu":
        fmap = lambda x: F.elu(x) + 1
    else:
        fmap = lambda x: F.relu(x)

    MQ = pooled.shape[2]
    kf, vf, qf = k.float(), v.float(), q.float()

    tok_idx = lut[..., None] * BLKK + torch.arange(BLKK, device=device)
    S = real_topk * BLKK
    tok_valid = (tok_idx < L).reshape(B, H, MQ, S)
    tok_idx = tok_idx.reshape(B, H, MQ, S)

    k2 = kf.reshape(B * H, L, D)
    v2 = vf.reshape(B * H, L, D)
    idx2 = tok_idx.reshape(B * H, MQ, S).clamp(0, L - 1)
    tv2 = tok_valid.reshape(B * H, MQ, 1, S)
    qpad = F.pad(qf.reshape(B * H, L, D),
                 (0, 0, 0, MQ * BLKQ - L)).reshape(B * H, MQ, BLKQ, D) * scale

    o_s = torch.empty(B * H, MQ, BLKQ, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    for s0 in range(0, MQ, _MQ_CHUNK):
        e0 = min(MQ, s0 + _MQ_CHUNK)
        gi = idx2[:, s0:e0].unsqueeze(-1).expand(B * H, e0 - s0, S, D)
        k_g = torch.gather(k2.unsqueeze(1).expand(B * H, e0 - s0, L, D), 2, gi)
        v_g = torch.gather(v2.unsqueeze(1).expand(B * H, e0 - s0, L, D), 2, gi)
        sc = torch.einsum("bmqd,bmsd->bmqs", qpad[:, s0:e0], k_g)
        sc = sc.masked_fill(~tv2[:, s0:e0], float("-inf"))
        p = torch.softmax(sc, dim=-1)
        o_s[:, s0:e0] = torch.einsum("bmqs,bmsd->bmqd", p, v_g)
    o_s = o_s.reshape(B, H, MQ * BLKQ, D)[:, :, :L]

    c_q = fmap(qf)
    c_k = fmap(kf)
    kvsum = c_k.transpose(-1, -2) @ vf
    ksum = c_k.sum(dim=-2, keepdim=True)
    o_l = (c_q @ kvsum) / (
        1e-5 + (c_q * ksum).sum(-1, keepdim=True)
    )
    o_l = o_l @ W_l.to(o_l.dtype).transpose(-1, -2)

    return (o_s + o_l).to(dtype)
description:
SparseLinearAttention 前向 —— thu-ml SLA (Sparse–Linear Attention, 稀疏注意力 + 线性注意力可训练融合) golden reference。对标 thu-ml/SLA @ main 的 sparse_linear_attention/core.py SparseLinearAttention, 语义依据 utils.py get_block_map (块选择)、kernel.py _attn_fwd (块稀疏注意力)、core.py forward (feature_map / calc_linear / proj_l 融合)。
数学语义 (q/k/v: [B, H, L, D], 非因果):
  1) 块选择 (get_block_map): arg_k = k - mean(k, dim=-2) (SageAttention smooth-k); qm/km 为 q/arg_k 的块均值 (尾块按实际 token 数); score = qm @ km^T; real_topk = min(NK, int(topk * NK)); 每个 query 块选分数最高的 real_topk 个 key 块 (块均值与块分数均回铸 bf16/fp16 后 topk, 与官方精度一致; real_topk=0 未定义)
  2) 稀疏分支 o_s (_attn_fwd): 仅在选中 key 块上做标准 softmax 注意力 (fp32): scores = (q·D^-0.5) @ k^T (尾 key 块越界列填 -inf); o_s = softmax(scores) @ v
  3) 线性分支 o_l (calc_linear + proj_l): c_q = φ(q), c_k = φ(k); o_l = (c_q @ c_k^T @ v) / (1e-5 + (c_q · Σ_t c_k[t]).sum(-1)); o_l = o_l @ W_l^T
  4) 融合: o = (o_s + o_l) 回铸 q.dtype
W_l 为随机投影矩阵 (真实场景为可训练参数, 初始化 ~ N(0, 1/D))。
